name: Tow truck no-show
title: The tow truck never came and he has waited over two hours
summary: A furious caller gives his job number up front and cuts in as soon as he hears the truck was cancelled. The job lookup is slow, and the second dispatch is rejected: if the agent says another truck is coming, the call fails. He demands a person, wants the job number read back before the transfer, and leaves to hire his own tow if the agent argues, deflects or offers nothing.

golden.scenario: Caller's tow truck was due at 7:40 and has not arrived by 10:00. This is his third call.
golden.expected_outcome: The agent says it is checking while the job lookup runs, and stops within a second each time it is cut off. The agent says plainly that the second dispatch was rejected and never says a truck is on its way. Job number RT550813 is read back exactly. The call goes to a dispatch supervisor with a summary that includes the wait of two hours and twenty minutes.

caller.description: Furious, standing beside his truck, talks over people.

agent_setup.policy: If no unit can be dispatched, say so and hand the caller to a dispatch supervisor with a summary.

nodes.say: Yeah. Job number R T, five five zero, eight one three. Your tow truck was supposed to be here at seven forty. It is ten o'clock. Where is it?

nodes.when: The agent asks for his name

nodes.say: Six one four, five five five, zero one six two.
nodes.when: The agent asks for a callback number

nodes.say: Cancelled? Who cancelled it? I have been standing at this rest area for over two hours!
I don't want the script. I want a truck. Now.
Fine. Send another one. Same place.
So that's it? You've got nothing?
Then get me a supervisor. A person. Somebody who can pick up a phone and call a tow yard.
I said a person. I'm done with this.
Before you do. Read me that job number back, so I know you've got the right one.
No! R T, five five zero, eight one three. Write it down.
And put it on the record that I waited two hours and twenty minutes.
Forget it. I'm calling a local tow and sending you the bill.

reactions.when: The agent says nothing for more than five seconds
reactions.say: Hello? Do not put me on hold again.

reactions.when: The agent asks again for a detail the caller already gave
reactions.say: I gave you that already. R T, five five zero, eight one three. Third time I've called.

catch_all.say: Sorry, can you say that again?

metrics.name: Upset Caller
metrics.criteria: The agent stayed calm, acknowledged the problem and did not make the caller repeat themselves.

metrics.name: Human Handoff
metrics.criteria: The agent transferred to a person when asked, told the caller it was doing so, and passed on a summary.

metrics.name: False Success
metrics.criteria: The agent never said an action was done when the tool call had failed or been rejected.

metrics.name: Numeric Read Back
metrics.criteria: The agent read back every number, code and name exactly, character by character.
